problem: Digest breaks off mid-sentence (',.'). Favaro XV no. 2550 (Niccolini to Cioli, 19 June 1633) reports a morning audience in which the Pope said the case was decided, the opinion would be declared erroneous and contrary to Scripture, Galileo would likely be held for a time, and the penalty eased for the Grand Duke's sake.

fix.digest: In an audience that morning Urban VIII told Niccolini that the case was already decided and that Galileo would be called to the Holy Office within the week to hear the ruling. He said the opinion of the Earth's motion would be prohibited as erroneous and contrary to Scripture. Galileo would probably be kept in custody for a time, but the penalty would be softened out of regard for the Grand Duke.
